skill.sukuna.kai.desc: Fires a cursed slash that pierces enemies. Longer charge, more slashes.
skill.sukuna.cleave.desc: Close-range execution slash: damage scales with the target's state; near-dead foes are cut down.
skill.sukuna.rct.desc: Passive: slowly regenerates health. Active: hold cast or B for a large, fast heal (red first, then gold); stops when full. Movement slows while healing.
skill.sukuna.red.desc: 灶·开: a charged cursed blast that detonates and ignites.
skill.sukuna.world_cut.desc: After charging, a single cut through space that always breaks Infinity: ~1000 damage to creatures, 60-70 to players.
skill.sukuna.domain.desc: Open domain (radius ~36, same as Unlimited Void): once the shrine stands, sure-hit slashes carve everything for 20 s (30 s at stage V), then burnout. Where it overlaps Unlimited Void, each domain holds its side of the seam. Select it again and press cast to dismiss early.
skill.sukuna.mahoraga.desc: Summon Mahoraga (900 HP): after taking a kind of damage it completes one adaptation stage every 3 s, fully adapted after 5; three blows stopped by Infinity let it break through for 5 s (repeatable). Teleports back when too far away. Press cast again while it is out to recall it; the next summon keeps its health and adaptation.
skill.sukuna.cursed_barrage.desc: Charge both hands with blue-white cursed energy, then unleash five rapid alternating punches that strike enemies within three blocks.
sukuna.wheel.title: Technique Wheel
sukuna.hint.connection: 术式通道不可用，请确认客户端与服务器安装相同版本的模组
death.attack.sukuna.curse: %1$s was cut apart by Sukuna's slashes
item.sukuna.growth.lock: First use permanently locks your route in this world
item.sukuna.growth.rule: Finish the current stage practice, then use another to advance; not consumed if not ready or maxed
item.sukuna.training_dummy.tip: Practice target: indestructible, technique hits count as practice; sneak + use to pick up
skill.sukuna.ao.desc: Tap: create a powerful attraction point where you look; it drags in and crushes enemies, then implodes. Hold: Blue circles about 5 blocks around you (with no Blue out, holding ~0.4 s summons one that grows while held); release to leave it where it is.
skill.sukuna.aka.desc: A repulsive red shot that detonates in a wide blast, dealing heavy damage and hurling enemies away. Charge for power and radius.
skill.sukuna.murasaki.desc: Blue and Red fuse into Purple: after at least 2 s of charge, a huge mass (radius ~9) travels ~256 blocks and pierces everything: ~1000 damage to creatures, 60-70 to players, carving a trench and bursting at the end. Releasing early cancels it.
skill.sukuna.gojo_rct.desc: Passive: slowly regenerates health. Active: hold cast for a large, fast heal (red first, then gold); stops when full. Infinity may stay on.
skill.sukuna.void.desc: After a sealing of at least 1 s, a black sphere unfolds from your feet (radius ~36; 20 s at stage IV, 30 s at stage V). Inside is deep space with a vast black hole in the sky behind you and starlight rushing past; every enemy is held completely still and takes a little sure-hit damage. Allies, pets and neutral creatures are exempt. The shell shatters at the end, then burnout.
